The most common win left on "50th Anniversary" is $100. The second biggest prize left is $1 million, and three of those are still unclaimed. The prize table is what defines a scratcher, and this page counts every level of it.

The numbers for "50th Anniversary" will change a little by tomorrow, and this page will change with them.
827.headline: What's actually left to win

847.body:
Before you buy "Bingo 50X", know that its $500,000 top prize is gone. The game still pays many smaller prizes, but the biggest one left is $100,000. That is less than the ticket advertises, though still a sizable prize.

The numbers for "Bingo 50X" will change a little by tomorrow, and this page will change with them.
847.headline: No $500,000 prize is left

891.body:
Most of the tickets for "Cash Explosion 25X" have been sold. The game is close to selling out. The key question is whether the tickets or the top prizes run out first. Right now, the top prizes are being claimed more slowly than the tickets are selling, which is a good sign.

Tomorrow's count on "Cash Explosion 25X" will be a little different. The game sells every day, and this page keeps track.
891.headline: Tickets sold so far
